whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Rohisha dance & Fitness studio,

I noticed your studio is located in the active Kankarbagh hub in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new class enrollments and trial bookings.

Maine aapke studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, dance & fitness batch timings, aur instructor gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/rohisha

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Rohisha dance & Fitness studio team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for your Kankarbagh location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact batch timings aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
